title: Nephrotoxicity of Iopamidol Versus Iodixanol in High-Risk Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the incidence of contrast-induced nephropathy (CIN) following the administration of iopamidol-370 (Iopamiro-370) and iodixanol-320 (Visipaque 320) in patients with chronic kidney disease undergoing coronary angiography.
